{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Inspect the revenue column for thousands separators
# If there are commas, they will appear in the string values
print("Checking revenue column for commas:")
print(sales['revenue'].str.contains(',', na=False).sum(), "rows contain commas")

# Check a few values that might have commas
print("\nExamples of revenue values containing commas:")
print(sales[sales['revenue'].str.contains(',', na=False)]['revenue'].head())"}
